name: Green Candle
description: Close is above open on the latest selected-period candle.

name: Volume Surge
description: Volume is at least twice its 20-period average.

name: Bullish Trend Alignment
description: Price and moving averages are aligned upward.

name: Bearish Trend Alignment
description: Price and moving averages are aligned downward.

name: Bullish EMA 9/21 Crossover
description: EMA 9 crosses above EMA 21 on the latest completed candle.

name: Bearish EMA 9/21 Crossover
description: EMA 9 crosses below EMA 21 on the latest completed candle.

name: Price Above Key EMAs
description: Close is above EMA 9, 21, 50 and 200.

name: Price Above Key SMAs
description: Close is above SMA 9, 21, 50 and 200.

name: Price Above Key WMAs
description: Close is above WMA 9, 21, 50 and 200.

name: Bullish Momentum
description: Price rises at least 2% with above-average volume.

name: RSI Oversold
description: 14-period RSI is below 30.

name: RSI Overbought
description: 14-period RSI is above 70.

name: 20-Period High Breakout
description: Close exceeds the prior 20-period high.

name: 20-Period Low Breakdown
description: Close falls below the prior 20-period low.

name: Near 52-Period High
description: Close is within 5% of its 52-period high.

name: Near 52-Period Low
description: Close is within 5% of its 52-period low.

name: Doji
description: Body is no more than 10% of the candle range.

name: Bullish Engulfing
description: Latest bullish body engulfs the previous bearish body.

name: Bearish Engulfing
description: Latest bearish body engulfs the previous bullish body.

name: NR7
description: Latest candle has the narrowest range of seven sessions.
